record_title: Quintic pump threshold and critical slowing in the Rabinovich wave system
provenance: A theorem for the dissipative Rabinovich three-wave equations derived from an exact critical energy factorization, LaSalle invariance, an explicit center-manifold reduction, and the classical equilibrium branch.
limitations: Positive damping and pump parameters are assumed. The t^{-1/4} law applies off the two-dimensional strong-stable manifold. The result does not classify later post-threshold bifurcations. The strict subthreshold theorem, exact nonzero equilibria and pitchfork itself are prior work; originality is claimed only for the equality closure, quintic critical mechanism and decay law. A 1981 review by the original authors and older Russian-language analyses remain residual coverage risks.
